script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(k.id AS CHAR), 'command', k.command, 'job_status', k.job_status, 'correlation_id', k.correlation_id,
                   'progress_percent', k.progress_percent, 'progress_message', k.progress_message,
                   'error_code', k.error_code, 'error_message', k.error_message, 'line_count', k.line_count,
                   'action', IF(JSON_VALID(k.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(k.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL),
                   'ia_no', IF(JSON_VALID(k.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(k.request_payload, '$.iaNo')), NULL)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job k
         WHERE k.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND k.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.key}}'
           AND k.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY k.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS key_job,
       CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS ia_id, g.stock_movement_no, g.item_assembly_status, g.posted_status, g.organization_id,
       CAST(g.issuing_operation_faci AS CHAR) AS plant_id, CAST(g.stock_movement_no_type AS CHAR) AS no_type,
       g.ia_v2_job_id AS ia_v2_job_id,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('step', p.step_name, 'ref', p.result_ref,
                            'young', (p.started_at > n.t - INTERVAL 120 SECOND),
                            'job', (SELECT q.job_status FROM gd_async_job q
                                     WHERE q.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND q.idempotency_key = p.result_ref AND q.is_deleted = 0
                                     ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT 1)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE {{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}} > 0
           AND p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND p.job_id = 'IAC|{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}}'
           AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS ia_lock,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(o.id AS CHAR), 'command', o.command, 'job_status', o.job_status, 'correlation_id', o.correlation_id,
                   'progress_percent', o.progress_percent, 'progress_message', o.progress_message,
                   'error_code', o.error_code, 'error_message', o.error_message, 'line_count', o.line_count,
                   'action', IF(JSON_VALID(o.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL),
                   'ia_no', IF(JSON_VALID(o.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.request_payload, '$.iaNo')), NULL))) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job o
         WHERE {{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}} > 0
           AND o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.command IN ('COMPLETE_IA', 'REVERT_IA')
           AND o.correlation_id = 'IA|{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}}'
           AND o.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_IA', 'COMMITTING_REVERT', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')) AS open_jobs,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(x.id AS CHAR), 'command', x.command, 'job_status', x.job_status, 'correlation_id', x.correlation_id,
                   'progress_percent', x.progress_percent, 'progress_message', x.progress_message,
                   'error_code', x.error_code, 'error_message', x.error_message, 'line_count', x.line_count,
                   'action', IF(JSON_VALID(x.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(x.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL),
                   'ia_no', IF(JSON_VALID(x.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(x.request_payload, '$.iaNo')), NULL)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job x
         WHERE {{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}} > 0
           AND x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND x.command IN ('COMPLETE_IA', 'REVERT_IA')
           AND x.correlation_id = 'IA|{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}}'
         ORDER BY x.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_job,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(y.id AS CHAR), 'command', y.command, 'job_status', y.job_status, 'correlation_id', y.correlation_id,
                   'progress_percent', y.progress_percent, 'progress_message', y.progress_message,
                   'error_code', y.error_code, 'error_message', y.error_message, 'line_count', y.line_count,
                   'action', IF(JSON_VALID(y.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(y.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL),
                   'ia_no', IF(JSON_VALID(y.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(y.request_payload, '$.iaNo')), NULL)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job y
         WHERE y.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND y.is_deleted = 0 AND y.command IN ('COMPLETE_IA', 'REVERT_IA')
           AND y.id = CAST(g.ia_v2_job_id AS UNSIGNED)) AS link_job,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM gd_async_job r
         WHERE {{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}} > 0
           AND r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.command = 'COMPLETE_IA'
           AND r.correlation_id = 'IA|{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}}'
           AND JSON_VALID(r.request_payload) AND COALESCE(g.stock_movement_no, '') <> ''
           AND (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.request_payload, '$.issuedNo')) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) = g.stock_movement_no) AS issued_by_job,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM gd_async_job c
         WHERE {{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}} > 0
           AND c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.command = 'COMPLETE_IA'
           AND c.correlation_id = 'IA|{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}}'
           AND c.job_status = 'COMPLETED'
           AND JSON_VALID(c.request_payload) AND COALESCE(g.stock_movement_no, '') <> ''
           AND (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.request_payload, '$.iaNo')) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) = g.stock_movement_no) AS completed_under,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('n', COUNT(*), 'level', MAX(b.batch_level_selection), 'date_format', MAX(b.date_format)) AS CHAR)
          FROM batch_number_config b
         WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND b.organization_id = (COALESCE(g.organization_id, '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.formOrg}}') COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
           AND b.item_id IS NULL AND b.item_category_id IS NULL
           AND b.is_deleted = 0) AS batch_cfg
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN sm_item_assembly g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = {{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}}
   AND g.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(h.id AS CHAR), 'item_id', h.item_id, 'item_qty', h.item_qty, 'item_uom', CAST(h.item_uom AS CHAR),
       'location_id', CAST(h.location_id AS CHAR), 'inventory_category', h.inventory_category, 'batch_no', h.batch_no,
       'issuing_operation_faci', CAST(h.issuing_operation_faci AS CHAR), 'organization_id', h.organization_id,
       'stock_movement_no', h.stock_movement_no, 'stock_movement_no_type', CAST(h.stock_movement_no_type AS CHAR),
       'item_assembly_status', h.item_assembly_status, 'posted_status', h.posted_status, 'table_hu', h.table_hu,
       'item_assembly_date', DATE_FORMAT(h.item_assembly_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),
       'manufacturing_date', DATE_FORMAT(h.manufacturing_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),
       'expired_date', DATE_FORMAT(h.expired_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),
       'remarks', h.remarks, 'remarks_2', h.remarks_2, 'remarks_3', h.remarks_3, 'ia_v2_job_id', h.ia_v2_job_id) AS j
  FROM sm_item_assembly h
 WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}}

script.code:
SELECT CAST(m.id AS CHAR) AS id, m.transaction_type, m.movement, m.trx_no, CAST(m.item_id AS CHAR) AS item_id,
       CAST(m.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id, CAST(m.bin_location_id AS CHAR) AS bin_location_id, CAST(m.batch_number_id AS CHAR) AS batch_number_id,
       CAST(m.handling_unit_id AS CHAR) AS handling_unit_id, m.inventory_category, m.quantity, m.base_qty, CAST(m.uom_id AS CHAR) AS uom_id,
       CAST(m.base_uom_id AS CHAR) AS base_uom_id, m.unit_price, m.total_price, m.costing_method_id
  FROM inventory_movement m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND m.id > {{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}}
   AND m.organization_id = (SELECT h.organization_id FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}})
   AND m.trx_no = (SELECT h.stock_movement_no FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}})
   AND m.transaction_type IN ('IA', 'IA-R')
   AND m.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY m.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(b.id AS CHAR), 'batch_number', b.batch_number, 'material_id', CAST(b.material_id AS CHAR),
       'plant_id', CAST(b.plant_id AS CHAR), 'organization_id', b.organization_id, 'transaction_no', b.transaction_no) AS j
  FROM batch b
  JOIN sm_item_assembly h
    ON h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}}
   AND h.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND b.transaction_no = h.stock_movement_no
   AND b.organization_id = h.organization_id
   AND b.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY b.id

script.code:
SELECT CAST(i.id AS CHAR) AS id
  FROM item i
 WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND i.is_deleted = 0
   AND i.serial_number_management = 1
   AND i.id IN (SELECT m.item_id
                  FROM inventory_movement m
                 WHERE m.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
                   AND m.id > {{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}}
                   AND m.organization_id = (SELECT h.organization_id FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}})
                   AND m.trx_no = (SELECT h.stock_movement_no FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}})
                   AND m.transaction_type IN ('IA', 'IA-R')
                   AND m.is_deleted = 0)

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(h.id AS CHAR) AS ia_id, h.item_assembly_status, h.ia_v2_job_id AS ia_v2_job_id, h.stock_movement_no,
       (SELECT p.result_ref
          FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND p.job_id = 'IAC|{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}}'
           AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref,
       (SELECT p.step_name
          FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND p.job_id = 'IAC|{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}}'
           AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_step
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN sm_item_assembly h
    ON h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IVSguard.data.iaId}}
   AND h.is_deleted = 0
